Metadata.title: Reference Q&A Portal
Metadata.description: An AI Q&A portal grounded in public references, with answers linked to verifiable sources.

Chat.confirmClearAria: Confirm clearing and start a new chat

Welcome.title: What would you like to explore?
Welcome.description: Ask questions about public references. I’ll organize the answers and include evidence you can verify.

library.title: Explore the reference library
library.description: Learn what the answers are based on and what the library covers
library.prompt: What references does this portal use to answer questions, and which topics do they cover?

topic.title: Explore a topic
topic.description: Organize key information from public references
topic.prompt: Summarize the main themes and key points in these public references, with citations.

perspectives.title: Compare perspectives
perspectives.description: Identify similarities and differences between viewpoints
perspectives.prompt: What different viewpoints appear in the references? Compare their similarities and differences, and cite sources for key conclusions.

sources.title: Check answer sources
sources.description: Learn how citations lead back to the original text
sources.prompt: How are sources cited in answers, and how can I verify an answer and its evidence?

Service.label: Service details
Service.referenceCount: {count, plural, one {# public reference} other {# public references}}

Announcement.completed: Answer complete. You can view its sources or ask another question.

Sources.title: Answer evidence
Sources.description: These are the reference excerpts retrieved for this answer. Check the original text; a citation does not guarantee that a conclusion is correct.

PrivacyDialog.title: Privacy and reference boundaries
PrivacyDialog.history: Conversation history is stored only in this browser and can be cleared from the page.
PrivacyDialog.model: New questions and necessary context are sent to the server and then to the configured model service.
PrivacyDialog.sensitive: Do not enter sensitive information such as passwords, ID numbers, or contact details.
PrivacyDialog.references: Answers are grounded in public references. When evidence is insufficient, the assistant should say so rather than guess.
